name: M7.RecipeSignature.pair_ideal_action
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ g : M7.Action.Record N, M7.SignatureIdeal.pairIdeal N (M7.Supports.polynomial (M7.Action.act g c).1) (M7.Supports.polynomial (M7.Action.act g c).2) = (M7.SignatureIdeal.pairIdeal N (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1) (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2)).map (M7.QuotientAuto.substitution g.unit)
guidance: Unfold actual pairIdeal and identify AffinePolynomial.image. Accepted action_images gives both generators as separate rho shift units times substituted original images. Use accepted rho_power_unit and Ideal.span_insert / Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit to remove these units. Ideal.map_span + Set.image_pair give the actual mapped pair; exchange is handled by Ideal.span_pair_comm. Do not assume arbitrary isometry or signature invariance. Return tactic lines without leading by.
